create.name: Keith Horan
create.bio:
Keith Horan is a meditation teacher in the west of Ireland who came to meditation at 22 and has practised and taught for more than two decades since. He studied with the Tibetan Buddhist teacher and psychologist Winston McCullough, trained with the Zen teacher Stephen Mugen Snyder Roshi, and was in the first group to complete a master's in mindfulness-based approaches at Bangor University in Wales. He is also an accredited coach, and he draws on both trainings to help people bring a settled, present mind into decisions and everyday life. Before this he worked as a teacher and in business, and he is the father of three teenagers.

Around Galway he leads a weekly Thursday evening group in Clarinbridge that combines gentle concentration practice with the Buddhist heart practices of kindness, compassion and gratitude, as well as occasional half-day workshops nearby in Kinvara. Online he runs a short free sitting every Wednesday at dawn and re:connect, a three-month mindfulness programme. His guided meditations, including MBSR-style body scans and breathing practices, are free on his website and on Insight Timer, and his tone is warm, unhurried and down to earth.

courses.title: Thursday Evening Meditation
courses.description: A weekly hour of group meditation at Setu Studio in Clarinbridge, County Galway, for beginners and experienced meditators. Sessions combine gentle concentration training, heart practices such as kindness and gratitude, and time for questions; booking is by WhatsApp.

courses.title: re:connect
courses.description: A three-month programme that pairs regular meditation guidance with coaching conversations about direction and purpose. It begins with a free introductory check-in call.

free_resources.title: Guided Mindfulness (MBSR)
free_resources.description: A 27-minute guided sitting on Insight Timer in the style of the MBSR programme, moving through breath, body, sounds and thoughts.

free_resources.title: Body Scan: Become Present With Yourself
free_resources.description: A slow guided body scan on Insight Timer, about half an hour long, for settling attention in physical sensation.

free_resources.title: Free Meditation Recordings
free_resources.description: A page of free recordings on his website, including MBSR-style body scans, mindful movement, walking practice, a three-step breathing space and meditations on equanimity and self-compassion.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Morning Meditation
free_resources.description: A free half-hour live sitting on Zoom early every Wednesday morning, with breath practice, a heart meditation and shared silence. Sign up by email to receive the link.

flags: Base: Insight Timer gives Galway, Ireland, and his own site says he lives in the west of Ireland; his weekly class is in Clarinbridge, County Galway. City set to Galway.
Coach-leaning: he presents himself as both meditation teacher and transformational coach; re:connect mixes the two. Meditation is the main thread of the site, so he was kept.
His podcast ('Keith & The Mindfulness Community' / Mindful Momentum) is described around stress and anxiety, so it is not listed and not linked.
Two Instagram accounts are linked from his site (@keithhoranmeditation and @keithmindfulness); neither could be read. The first is used as instagram_url.
Facebook links on his site point to a 'Being Mindful Ireland' page and a group, so facebook_url is left null.
Two site photos are outdoor shots in a hat and scarf; they match the Insight Timer headshot (same beard and face) but a human may prefer only the headshot.
